concepts.name: Approval
concepts.description: The activity of approving a document or decision.

judge.reason: Approval is a class of business process activities or events where a document or decision is approved. It represents many individual approval events, making it a 'type'.

concepts.name: Company
concepts.description: An organization or subsidiary that acts as the buyer in the purchasing process.

judge.reason: Company is a fundamental organizational entity (class/type) in business processes, representing the buyer. It is not a duplicate of Subsidiary, which is a more specific subtype.

concepts.name: Consignment
concepts.description: A business arrangement where goods are stored at the buyer's site but owned by the vendor until consumed.

judge.reason: Consignment (or consignment case) represents a specific type of procurement arrangement or process category, of which there can be many individual instances (cases) in a business process log.

concepts.name: Consumption
concepts.description: The activity of consuming goods, particularly in a consignment arrangement.

judge.reason: Consumption is a business activity/event representing the act of consuming goods, which is a valid class of events in a business process ontology.

concepts.name: ECPurchaseOrder
concepts.description: A purchase order that includes an SRM subprocess before or around item creation.

judge.reason: ECPurchaseOrder is a specific subtype of PurchaseOrder, distinct from StandardPurchaseOrder and FrameworkPurchaseOrder, characterized by the inclusion of an SRM subprocess. It represents a class of individual documents in the business process.

concepts.name: EventualResponseRule
concepts.description: A rule defining that an activity must eventually be followed by another.

judge.reason: An EventualResponseRule is a specific type of process constraint or rule (similar to PrecedenceRule) that can have multiple instances representing different activity pairs in a business process.

concepts.name: FrameworkPurchaseOrder
concepts.description: A purchase order that supports recurring invoices over a period of time.

judge.reason: FrameworkPurchaseOrder (also known as a blanket purchase order) is a specific subtype of PurchaseOrder used in procurement. It represents a class of documents, making it a 'type' level concept.

concepts.name: Goods
concepts.description: Physical items or products purchased from a vendor.

judge.reason: Goods represents a class of physical items or products purchased from a vendor, which is a fundamental object type in a purchasing process.

concepts.name: GoodsReceipt
concepts.description: The activity of recording the receipt of goods.

judge.reason: GoodsReceipt is a standard business process activity/event representing the recording of received goods. It is distinct from the 'Receipt' document concept.

concepts.name: Invoice
concepts.description: A document requesting payment for goods or services provided.

judge.reason: Invoice is a fundamental document type in business processes, representing a class of individual invoice documents. It is not a duplicate of any other listed concept, though 'RecurringInvoice' is a subtype.

concepts.name: InvoiceClearance
concepts.description: The activity of clearing an invoice for payment.

judge.reason: InvoiceClearance is a distinct business process activity/event representing the clearing of an invoice for payment. It is a class of events, so it is classified as a type.

concepts.name: InvoiceCreation
concepts.description: The activity of creating an invoice.

judge.reason: InvoiceCreation represents a class of business process activities (events) where invoices are created. Each instance of this activity in a process log would be an individual event, so it is classified as a type.

concepts.name: InvoiceHandling
concepts.description: The activity of processing or handling an invoice.

judge.reason: InvoiceHandling represents a class of activities or process steps related to the processing of an invoice, which is a valid object type in a business process ontology.

concepts.name: InvoiceReceipt
concepts.description: The activity of recording the receipt of an invoice.

judge.reason: InvoiceReceipt is a distinct business process activity (event type) representing the recording of an invoice's receipt, which is a class of individual event instances.

concepts.name: ItemDeletion
concepts.description: The activity of deleting an item.

judge.reason: ItemDeletion represents a class of activities (events) within a business process, specifically the action of deleting an item (such as a purchase order item). This is a standard process activity type.

concepts.name: OrderConfirmation
concepts.description: A document or communication from a vendor confirming the receipt and acceptance of a purchase order.

judge.reason: OrderConfirmation is a distinct class of documents in the procurement process, representing a vendor's confirmation of a purchase order. It is a type with many potential individual instances and does not duplicate any other listed concept.

concepts.name: PaymentBlockCreation
concepts.description: The activity of creating a payment block on an invoice.

judge.reason: PaymentBlockCreation is a class of activities (events) representing the action of creating a payment block on an invoice, which is a standard event type in business process execution.

concepts.name: PrecedenceRule
concepts.description: A rule defining the required order of activities.

judge.reason: A precedence rule is a class of process constraints or rules that define the ordering of activities. It is a valid ontological concept in the domain of process mining and business process modeling.

concepts.name: ProcessVariant
concepts.description: A specific path or sequence of activities followed in the purchasing process.

judge.reason: ProcessVariant represents a class of process execution paths (such as three-way matching or two-way matching) in a business process. It is a valid ontology class (type) and does not duplicate any other listed concepts.

concepts.name: PurchaseOrder
concepts.description: A document issued by a buyer to a seller indicating types, quantities, and agreed prices for products or services.

judge.reason: PurchaseOrder is a standard business document class representing a type of document issued by a buyer to a seller. It has many individual instances in a business process.

concepts.name: PurchaseOrderApprovalChange
concepts.description: The activity of changing the approval status of a purchase order.

judge.reason: PurchaseOrderApprovalChange represents a specific activity (event type) within the purchase order lifecycle, which is a valid class of events in a business process ontology.

concepts.name: PurchaseOrderItem
concepts.description: An individual line item within a purchase order.

judge.reason: PurchaseOrderItem is a fundamental entity type in procurement processes, representing individual line items within a purchase order. It is distinct from the PurchaseOrder itself and serves as a common case notion in process mining.

concepts.name: PurchaseOrderItemChange
concepts.description: The activity of making changes to a purchase order item.

judge.reason: PurchaseOrderItemChange represents a class of activities (events) in a business process, specifically the modification of a purchase order item. It is a valid ontology class (type) and does not duplicate any existing concepts, though it may have subtypes like QuantityChange.

concepts.name: PurchaseOrderItemCreation
concepts.description: The activity of creating a purchase order item.

judge.reason: PurchaseOrderItemCreation represents a class of activities (events) in a business process, specifically the creation of a purchase order item. It has many individual occurrences across different process executions, making it a type.

concepts.name: PurchaseRequisition
concepts.description: An internal document that defines the need for a purchase before an order is created.

judge.reason: PurchaseRequisition is a standard business document class representing an internal request for purchasing. It has many individual instances in a typical procurement process and is distinct from the activity of creating it (PurchaseRequisitionCreation).

concepts.name: PurchaseRequisitionCreation
concepts.description: The activity of creating a purchase requisition.

judge.reason: PurchaseRequisitionCreation represents a class of events (an activity type) in the business process, where individual executions of this activity are its instances. It is a valid ontology class and does not duplicate any other listed concept.

concepts.name: QuantityChange
concepts.description: The activity of changing the quantity of an item.

judge.reason: QuantityChange is a class of events representing the activity of changing the quantity of an item in a business process. It is a specific type of activity, distinct from the broader PurchaseOrderItemChange.

concepts.name: Receipt
concepts.description: A document acknowledging that goods or services have been received.

judge.reason: Receipt is a class of documents acknowledging the receipt of goods or services, which is a fundamental entity type in the purchasing process, distinct from activities like GoodsReceipt.

concepts.name: RecurringInvoice
concepts.description: An invoice that occurs repeatedly over a period of time, typically supported by a framework order.

judge.reason: RecurringInvoice is a specific subtype of Invoice representing a class of documents that occur repeatedly. It is a valid ontology class (type).

concepts.name: Resource
concepts.description: An entity, either human or automated, that executes or records activities.

judge.reason: Resource is a fundamental class in business process modeling representing the actors (human or system) that perform activities. It is a type, not an instance or a non-type attribute.

concepts.name: SRMSubprocess
concepts.description: A Supplier Relationship Management subprocess.

judge.reason: SRMSubprocess represents a specific category of subprocesses within the procurement domain, making it a valid object type.

concepts.name: StandardPurchaseOrder
concepts.description: A standard type of purchase order used for one-off purchases.

judge.reason: StandardPurchaseOrder is a specific subtype of PurchaseOrder representing a class of documents used for one-off purchases. It is a valid ontology class (type).

concepts.name: Vendor
concepts.description: An external entity that supplies goods or services to the company.

judge.reason: Vendor is a standard business entity representing external suppliers. It is a class whose members are many individual supplier organizations, making it a 'type'.

concepts.name: VendorInvoiceCreation
concepts.description: The activity of a vendor creating an invoice.

judge.reason: VendorInvoiceCreation is a specific activity type in the purchasing process representing the event of a vendor generating an invoice. It is distinct from the internal 'InvoiceReceipt' or 'InvoiceCreation' (which may refer to internal invoice entry or self-billing).
